LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
The full message from the director is included at the bottom of the game description page.

Lost in darkness, a boy drawn into a twisted dream, no way out. Vapor World: Over The Mind is a narrative-driven souls-like platformer focused on deflection combat, set in a vast atmospheric dreamscape painted entirely by hand.


Memory lost, a boy caught in a dark past. Nightmares bloomed from that past drag him deeper into darkness. The only way back to reality stands sealed before him. Lindsey, veiled keeper of dreams, tells him the door will open only when the dreams of those swallowed by trauma are gathered. Across the unfolding nightmare, the journey back to reality begins.


FACE THE NIGHTMARE
Defeat the Traumas, mighty bosses that haunt this world, and their offspring Seeds. Overcome each challenging battle and draw in the strength of every creature you break open.


EXPLORE A MIND SHAPED BY SORROW AND REGRET
This dark dreamworld sprawls vast and unknowable, held together by a force beyond understanding. Recall each lost fragment and press deeper into the darkness. Push heavy obstacles aside, climb hidden ladders, and discover new abilities along the way.


UNRAVEL THE DARKEST DREAM AND FACE THE HIDDEN TRUTH
Every fragment you recall brings forgotten memories closer to the surface. Descend through a dream filled with unimaginable dangers, and uncover the secrets veiled at its core.

A MESSAGE FROM THE DIRECTOR

Dear players, this is the director of Vapor World.

Before I begin, I want to thank everyone who has picked up our game, even though there is still much for us to improve.

To everyone who has had a poor experience with this release, I am sincerely sorry.

We looked for a faster way to reach you and could not find one on Xbox, so this message is here in the store description instead.

[On this release]

We do not think the standard we have to meet changes because this is Game Preview. You paid for it, so it is a release like any other, and we knew we owed you the best experience we could give.

With this release we did not reach that standard. There is no excuse for that. I am sorry.

There were many twists and turns on the way to launch. We tried to take on too much, and ended up unable to take care of what mattered most. We made mistakes at the end, and that responsibility, too, is ours.

We know there is much left to build out. We will make sure to complete what is missing and repay your interest and support with a good game.

[On the build that shipped first]

We have confirmed that a version check error during Xbox certification put an old build live at launch.

Some of the issues you are raising have already been fixed in the current build.

This one is on us as well. I am ashamed of it.

[Why the updates were late]

On Xbox, every build has to pass both build verification and submission certification, and a single round takes a long time. The fix had to go through certification again from the start. A weekend fell inside that window, and our response here ended up far slower than on other platforms.

Once again, I am sorry that our ability to respond fell short and kept you waiting.

[What happened after launch]

The thing we were criticized for most right after launch was the use of AI-generated video in our cutscenes.

With the time and money we had, we judged that combat and level design mattered most in this genre and put our effort there, and we chose AI for the cutscenes.

I did not expect our fans to react this strongly against the use of AI. That was my failure. I am sorry.

That same day we made two promises. No AI in our cutscenes from that point on, and every AI cutscene already in the game removed and replaced with work we made ourselves. We kept both of them the same day.

There is a reason we could undo it that fast. Every cutscene in this game was originally an in-game cutscene built with our own hands. Switching them to AI video happened right before launch, and our own originals were still there. All we had to do was take the AI versions out and put ours back.

The cutscenes for the coming episodes will be made by our own hands as well.

[What we have done since]

We fixed the error that reset save data. The most common piece of feedback was that movement felt slow and heavy, so we greatly improved movement speed and the responsiveness of actions. We have read every report and review that came in after launch, one by one, and they are what shaped this update.

Certification on Xbox takes time, so even the fixes we have already made can reach you later than we would like.

Removing the AI video from the build reset save data. We did not tell you before it happened, and for that I am sincerely sorry once again. If you have not received the update yet, your save data may be reset a few more times. This time, we are telling you in advance.

[What we will hold ourselves to]

We will ship updates on a fixed cycle, and we will tell you what is in each one before it goes out. Every update through full release is included at no extra cost for everyone who owns the game now.

We have not found a place on Xbox where we can post announcements, so the roadmap will go up on our Discord. It will lay out which update ships when, what goes into it, and how much playtime each one adds. Please come by and take a look.

There are five of us making this game. That can make us slower than we would like, but we will fix things one by one, without fail. Thank you for waiting, and for bearing with us.

Thank you to everyone taking part in Game Preview. From here on we will say more, and say it earlier, so you can watch this game being built instead of hearing about it afterwards.

To everyone who was disappointed and still took the time to write: your posts are what shaped this update. Thank you.

I am sorry once more for the experience this launch gave you. We will keep building this into something worth your time, and we will repay you with a good game.

If you have more questions, come to our Discord and tell me directly. I am always there. Whatever you tell me, I will listen and do my best to put it into the game.

discord.gg/uBzxgTmFSU

To everyone who has taken an interest in our game, thank you once again, sincerely.

Young Kim
Director of ALIVE
LocalizedProperties.ProductTitle: Vapor World: Over The Mind (Game Preview)
LocalizedProperties.ShortDescription: Lost in darkness, a boy drawn into a twisted dream, no way out. Vapor World is a narrative-driven souls-like platformer with deflection combat in a dreamlike world. Descend into a shattered mind seeking lost memories. Face a dark, beautiful world born of anguish and regret.

Features: A vast, ever-unfolding seamless world
New skills and abilities earned through exploration
Hand-painted art breathing in a distinct, painterly style
Challenging combat brought to life by the personality of every creature
A grand epic told through the stories of many characters across a vast world
A special sense of space expressed through 2D art
Intricate, responsive actions that react to every input
Break or move obstacles, climb high walls, ascend ladders, and more
Stealth gameplay utilizing crouching and cover
Elegant animations alive with a painterly art style
An epic, beautiful soundtrack that heightens the thrill of combat
LocalizedProperties.MinimumNotes: OS: Windows 10;Processor: Intel or AMD at 3.0 GHz;Memory: 16 GB RAM;Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050;DirectX: Version 11;VRAM: 6 GB;Network: Broadband Internet connection;Storage: 15 GB available space
LocalizedProperties.ReleaseNotes:
Along with this update, we have left a message from the director in the game description. We would be sincerely grateful if you could take a moment to read it.

WHAT'S NEW

- New games starting with items and enemies missing
- The opening scene showing a black screen with audio only on a new game
- Controls locking up when picking up an item right after defeating an enemy in the cemetery, before the reward notice appears
- Cutscenes ignoring the audio settings
- Audio settings resetting to defaults after a loading screen
- Most sounds dropping out when entering the train station
- The wrong area's ambience playing after respawning
- The potion-use action not working
- Broken collision on the ladder section blocking the climb to the weapon
- Loading never finishing after interacting with the chair in the train car
- Wrong dialogue and subtitles for the Agent
- Soldiers' attack sounds continuing through a cutscene entered without defeating them
- Items in another area disappearing after quitting without breaking a destructible
- The player being detected instantly on returning to the stealth area after respawning, even with no enemy in sight
- Nearby enemies losing their alert state during an execution
...

The rest of the fixes that would not fit here can be found in the patch notes on our Discord channel.

We would be truly grateful if you keep sending us reports through Discord. Your posts are what built this list. Thank you sincerely.

discord.gg/uBzxgTmFSU
